title: Atmos™ Rewards expands with new Unlocked experiences from Alterra Mountain Company, Nordstrom and Pebble Beach Resorts
summary: New offerings include ski-and-stay packages, heli-skiing experiences, private holiday shopping events, golf getaways, culinary experiences and other premium lifestyle experiences.
body_markdown:
With **Ikon Pass,** Atmos Rewards members will be able to redeem points through Atmos Unlocked for select ski and mountain experiences this season, including a CMH heli-skiing package, Steamboat Ski Resort stay-and-ski offerings and a Steamboat Ski Resort bundle that includes a lift ticket, First Tracks and True West lounge access. The lineup also includes 26/27 Ikon Pass bundles and other mountain travel offerings, with Crystal Mountain offering a particularly strong local connection for Pacific Northwest members.


Atmos Rewards will also come to life on the mountain through a weekly Atmos Members Day on the slopes, special member activations and other opportunities to engage with the program throughout the season.
